rcsb_polymer_entity_name_com.name: FAD pyrophosphorylase,FMN adenylyltransferase,Flavin adenine dinucleotide synthase

rcsb_target_cofactors.mechanism_of_action:
Flavin mononucleotide (FMN) is a precursor to flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD) which is involved in metabolic redox reactions critical to a variety of functions, including ATP production, DNA repair, apoptosis, and protein folding.[L54221,L54241] Administered systemically, FMN serves to supplement endogenous supply in patients who may otherwise be deficient.[A274616]

For its indicated use in corneal collagen cross-linking, FMN acts as a photoenhancer. When used with a system delivering UV-A light, FMN generates singlet oxygen which is responsible for inducing the formation of cross-links within the corneal collagen.[L54221]
